subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Observar, em poemas concretos, o formato, a distribuição e a diagramação das letras do texto na página.

components.description_pt: Observar a distribuição visual e tipográfica de letras em poemas concretos
components.description_en: Observe the visual layout and typographic distribution of letters in concrete poems

components.description_pt: Identificar como o arranjo do texto na página contribui para o significado da poesia concreta
components.description_en: Identify how the arrangement of text on the page contributes to meaning in concrete poetry
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how a text's structure contributes to its overall meaning

components.description_pt: Reconhecer a organização espacial como elemento compositivo em poemas concretos
components.description_en: Recognize the role of spatial organization as a compositional element in concrete poems
components.cc_component_description: Identify structural elements of poems such as verse, rhythm, and meter

cc_matches.description: Compare and contrast the structure of two or more texts and analyze how the differing structure of each text contributes to its meaning and style.

Explain major differences between poems, drama, and prose, and refer to the structural elements of poems (e.g., verse, rhythm, meter) and drama (e.g., casts of characters, settings, descriptions, dialogue, stage directions) when writing or speaking about a text.
